title: Apache AH-64E vs Ka-52 Alligator
shortAnswer: The AH-64E Apache Guardian is the world's most combat-proven attack helicopter with advanced sensors and Hellfire missiles. The Ka-52 Alligator is Russia's coaxial-rotor attack helicopter with better speed and armor but less combat experience. Apache wins on proven capability; Ka-52 on raw performance.
verdict: Apache has decades of proven combat success and superior sensors/weapons integration. Ka-52 has innovative design (coaxial rotors, ejection seats) but Ukraine revealed serious survivability issues. Apache is the safer choice.

lines.hook: One costs 35 million dollars. The other costs 16. Guess which one survives.
lines.tape: Proven American firepower against Russian engineering that looked better on paper than over Ukraine.
rounds: 300 against 293. Seven kilometers an hour. Nobody has ever won a war with that.
Hellfire fires and forgets. Vikhr makes you sit there holding the beam.
2,400 built versus 250. One is a standard, the other is a boutique.
Half the price. You could field two Alligators for one Apache and still save.
Three decades of wars against one, and that one went badly.
lines.verdict: Apache takes it 3-2. Pick the Ka-52 only if budget beats battle record.

youtubeTitle: AH-64E Apache Guardian vs Ka-52 Alligator: Which Attack Helicopter Wins?
youtubeDescription:
A head-to-head breakdown of the AH-64E Apache Guardian and Russia's Ka-52 Alligator across speed, primary missile, production numbers, unit cost and combat record. The Ka-52 is faster and far cheaper, but the Apache's fire-and-forget Hellfire and decades of combat use decide it. Full stat-by-stat comparison and a clear verdict.

Figures accurate as of October 2026. Statistics change over time — see the full, maintained comparison at https://www.aversusb.net/compare/apache-vs-ka-52
